Inspect this step

01 / Collection

Link the artifact.
Keep its version.

A specification, invoice, supplier statement, or prior-entry reference is evidence to inspect. It does not become a verified conclusion simply because it is attached.

02 / Human review

Make the disagreement
a visible decision.

Review alternatives and exceptions with the importer and broker. Reject or revise an unsupported assumption, with a reason and evidence references.

03 / Handoff

Open questions
belong in the packet.

Assemble a source manifest and decision log for broker discussion. Export keeps the unresolved issues; it is not transmission, filing, or release.

Responsibility remains specific

A prepared packet
does not move legal authority.

Proposed responsibility model
ParticipantResponsibility
Importer of recordSupplies and owns the facts; retains reasonable-care responsibility.
PreparerOrganizes sources, alternatives, exceptions, and review history.
Customs brokerReviews evidence and incorporates usable material into entry preparation.
CounselAssesses questions outside the selected lane or professional scope.
Government authorityIs not replaced by a software suggestion or packet approval.
